text.en:
30th. APRIL, 2001 No. S 29

SYARIAH COURTS ACT (CHAPTER 184} Notification under section 1(1} In exercise of the power conferred by section 1(1 J of the Emergency (Syariah Court) Order, 1998 (S 37/98), His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan hereby appoints the 1st. day of Muharam, 1422 Hijriah corresponding to the 26th. day of March, 2001 as the date on which the Syariah Courts Act (with the exception of section 3) shall commence. Dated this lOth. day of Muharam, 1422 Hijriah corresponding to the 4th. day of April, 2001.

DATO PADUKA HAJI AWANG ADANAN BIN BEGAWAN PEHIN SIRAJA KHATIB DATO SERI SETIA HAJI AWANG MOHD. YUSOF Permanent Secretary, Prime Minister's Office, Brunei Darussalam.
